name: ogg2mp3
description: Convert QQ Music .ogg/.oggh files on macOS to .mp3 with embedded cover art and metadata.

interface.shortDescription: Convert QQ Music .ogg/.oggh to .mp3 with cover art and metadata.
interface.longDescription: QQ Music's macOS app stores audio as Vorbis-in-Ogg with the cover image hidden in the macOS Resource Fork as an ICNS resource. ogg2mp3 reassembles audio + cover + metadata into a standard MP3 with id3v2.3 tags. Supports single-file conversion, batch directory processing (recursive, skip-existing, dry-run), read-only metadata inspection, and environment self-check. Refuses to run as root.
defaultPrompt: 把这个 QQ 音乐文件转成 MP3
批量转换 QQ 音乐文件夹
检查 ogg2mp3 环境是否就绪
